question_text:
A small spherical liquid drop of radius $r$ and density $\rho$ falls with terminal velocity $v$ in still air. The coefficient of viscosity of air is $\eta$ and the density of air can be neglected. Consider the following statements regarding the terminal velocity $v$ of the droplet.
(A) It is directly proportional to $r^2$.
(B) It is directly proportional to $\rho$.
(C) It is inversely proportional to $\eta$.
